Backend GET /api/dashboard/admin returns funnel{clicks,uses,not_used,conversion,ticket,origins[]} with correct math and trend.count. Frontend AdminDashboard renders new KPI row (cupons-usados, cliques-total, nao-utilizaram, taxa-conversao in 'X,X%' format, ticket-medio) plus admin-origins-card with origin-* bars, and updates live via WS on clique_cupao and split_executado. Backend 3/3 PASS. Frontend 100% PASS.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes_data.py admin_dashboard funnel.ticket is computed from totals over ALL redemptions (t = totals(reds)), while KPI Receita/Comissões cards display totals over ALL time as well — consistent. However uses (funnel.uses = t['count']) is also all-time while trend.count/period metric is 30d-vs-30d; be aware conversion (uses/clicks) mixes all-time uses with all-time clicks (claims collection is unbounded). If clicks are pruned but redemptions retained, conversion will spuriously exceed 100%.

backend/routes_data.py _click_origin still returns raw request.query_params['src'].capitalize() — a malicious src like ';;drop' or containing ';' would land in origins list verbatim. Frontend renders as text (safe) but Origens card testid uses .toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-') which is safe; CSV export in RecentClicks may still be vulnerable. Whitelist src.

frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.jsx clique_cupao handler pushes a NEW origin entry to state when ev.origem is not found (line 60). Initial /api/dashboard/admin returns only top-6 origins sorted by clicks; if a rare origin (e.g., 'QR / direto') was truncated off, live click will re-add it starting from 1 instead of its true count. Reload fixes it. Consider fetching top-N with N large enough or reloading funnel on each event.

frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.jsx line 54: split_executado handler still increments comissoes by v*0.10 while receita increments by v (v = ev.valor_plataforma). This is the same double-count discrepancy flagged in iter17/18 and remains unfixed. Verified live: after 40 € redemption receita +4 € (correct), comissoes should NOT also +0.4 €. Backend commission_paid is already the full 10% split; UI should mirror +v for both or fetch fresh totals.

backend POST /api/redemptions response body does NOT include 'id' field (UI test observed None). Verify Redemption response schema — WS event carries ref, but the HTTP response should also return id for client-side idempotency/UX.

backend/routes_data.py admin_dashboard reads db.coupon_claims WITHOUT time filter (claims = find({})), so funnel.clicks/origins are ALL-TIME while funnel.ticket is derived from ALL-TIME totals. That's internally consistent but not 'last 30d' — label ambiguity risk in UI.
seed_data_creation: Backend test created 1 CLUB-10 redemption 40€ (idempotency=iter19-<uuid>, id in JSON response was None but persisted server-side). Frontend UI test created 1 more CLUB-10 redemption 40€ (idempotency=iter19-ui-<uuid>). Also 2 fresh coupon_claims for CLUB-10?src=instagram with unique Instagram UAs (one backend, one UI).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin funnel + origins card + live WS updates on clique_cupao/split_executado all working. New KPI testids: kpi-cupons-usados, kpi-cliques-total, kpi-nao-utilizaram, kpi-taxa-conversao, kpi-ticket-medio, kpi-receita-sistema. Origens card testid admin-origins-card contains origin-<slug> bars (slug = origem.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-')). POST /api/redemptions body requires 'code' and 'idempotency_key' (NOT 'cupom'). To force fresh clicks past the 12h ip+ua dedupe use requests.get with a unique User-Agent header — Playwright browser fetch cannot override UA. Comissoes double-count on split_executado (frontend) still unfixed since iter17.
rca of the issue: No production bug found in this iteration. Two carried-over frontend inconsistencies (comissoes double-count on split_executado and origins re-init on live add) remain flagged for main agent.
